title: minimap
summary: MSUI draws the md5translate-resolved outdoor tile plane and authored WMO interior tiles with separate exact six-level zoom laws, authored cluster controls, zone identity, tracking/mail icons, party/resource/quest/tracked-creature dots, cross-interior grey tint, and the corpse skull. Ordinary player party blips consume the exact party1..party4 compact roster (own subgroup, packet order, capped at four), while the protected SuperUI possession projection remains separate. Blip positions prefer live transforms and fall back to out-of-range PARTY_MEMBER_STATS X/Y snapshots; members within the exact 0.8 split use the 10.4-pixel blue ObjectIcons cell and farther members use the shared 38.4-pixel rotating rim arrow. The corpse follows the same fifth-slot split: an in-range skull above the player arrow or an out-of-range rotating rim arrow below it. AreaPOI landmarks use exact map/flag candidacy, 0.8 range split, signed-importance/distance nearest-three ranking, 8x8 POI cells and rotating real-art rim arrows. Outdoor tiles receive the reference gamma-space diffuse/ambient day-night MODULATE with its +96 floor while WMO tiles stay white. Interior WMO tiles now first pass through the fixed 256x256 opaque-black, blend-off, alpha-GEQUAL-224/255 composite under a 1.5x view radius, and the screen blit samples its middle two-thirds; this preserves the reference minification that removes filtered shared-wall seams and authored one-texel gaps.

openItems.text: No interior (WMO) minimap: no portal flood-fill group selection, no interior tile stems, and no separate indoor zoom index/radius table {150,120,90,60,40,25} - indoors keeps showing the outdoor ADT plane
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: The existing WMO minimap path performs interior containment, authored tile-stem projection, portal/group preparation, separate zoom state and the exact {150,120,90,60,40,25} yard radius table. Registry was stale.

openItems.text: Outdoor zoom radii are ad-hoc (halfTile = 0.10 + zoom*0.025 tiles, ~53-120 yd) instead of the verified chunk table {14,12,10,8,6,4}*0.5*33.33 yd (~67-233 yd), so every zoom level shows a different world radius than 1.12
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Outdoor projection now uses the exact reversed-storage equivalent of Benilla's {14,12,10,8,6,4} chunk table, and both indoor/outdoor controls now share Benilla's increasing-index Zoom In convention.

openItems.text: AreaPOI landmark layer missing: no in-range POIIcons cells (Flags&2 rows) and no nearest-3 rotating rim arrows ranked by signed Importance within 694.44 yd
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: AreaPoiCatalog decodes the exact 29-field table and selects current-map Flags&1 candidates. Rows at or within 0.8 of the active radius draw Flags&2 Icon<64 cells from the 8x8 POI atlas; farther rows within 694.444 yd rank by signed Importance then distance, cap at three and draw the real rotating rim-arrow texture at the exact 0.8 rim. Landmark names join shared minimap tooltip ownership. Focused checks pass.

openItems.text: Quest-giver dots missing: DIALOG_STATUS 7 (REWARD2) never draws the gold cell-3 dot
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: status-7 NPCs draw an 8x8 ObjectIcons cell-3 gold dot, hard-culled at the active radius, with NPC-name tooltip ownership.

openItems.text: Quest-giver dots do not yet apply current Benilla's 0xffb0b0b0 tint when the NPC and player are on opposite indoor-containment sides.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: resource, tracked-unit and quest dots compare collision-backed WMO area containment at player and candidate positions and apply exact 0xffb0b0b0 on mismatch.

openItems.text: Focused laws and source wiring pass. Needs live traversal at all outdoor/interior zoom levels, including confirmation that the fixed 256x256 alpha-tested composite removes shared-wall and authored bake-gap lines without changing the visible radius, plus AreaPOI icon/rim-arrow art, ranking, rotation and tooltip checks alongside reward-ready quest NPC/resource/party layering.
Tracked-creature dots missing: Find Creatures / Hunter's Mark red cell-1 dots are not drawn (only the resource leg exists)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: ObjectIcons cell 1 draws for PLAYER_TRACK_CREATURES type-mask matches and UNIT_DYNFLAG_TRACK_UNIT, with player Humanoid fallback, SpellShapeshiftForm creature-type override, range/aperture cull, tint and tooltip.

openItems.text: Outdoor tiles are drawn untinted - the reference's day-night MODULATE (ambient/diffuse lerp with +96 floor) is not applied
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: MinimapUiLaw.OutdoorDayTint implements the exact gamma-space Rec.601 ambient luma, +96/256 white lift, then 0.25 diffuse + 0.75 lifted-ambient blend. DrawMovingMinimap packs that tint into every outdoor tile vertex; the authored WMO interior path remains full white. Focused checks pass.

openItems.text: MSUI retained PARTY_MEMBER_STATS X/Y snapshots but minimap party dots only accepted streamed entities, hard-culled at an approximate aperture, used a primitive circle, and had no out-of-range party rim-arrow path. Benilla prefers the live transform, falls back to the stats position, splits at 0.8 radius, uses ObjectIcons cell 4 for the in-range dot and the rotating minimap arrow on the rim.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: MinimapUiLaw owns the exact 0.8 split, screen projection, 10.4-pixel dot and 38.4-pixel arrow geometry. The renderer resolves live positions first and stats X/Y second, paints ObjectIcons cell 4 after the player arrow, and paints rotating out-of-range arrows before it. Partytest seats and boundary/rotation projections have deterministic checks; the full interface suite passes.

openItems.text: MSUI drew the corpse skull only inside the 0.8 minimap aperture and discarded it outside, while current Benilla treats the corpse as the fifth party/corpse slot: an out-of-range rotating rim arrow before the player arrow, or the skull afterward when in range.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: DrawMinimapCorpseArrow reuses MinimapUiLaw's exact 0.8 projection and shared rotating-arrow art for same-map out-of-range corpses. The existing skull path now runs after the player arrow, while the arrow path runs before it; focused projection and source wiring checks pass.

openItems.text: MSUI projected every retained raid member onto the minimap, while current Benilla's place_party_raid_blips iterates party_slots: only the recipient's own subgroup in packet order, capped at party1 through party4.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: The ordinary player minimap path now consumes PartyFrameMembers, the existing exact own-subgroup/four-slot projection. The protected SuperUI controlled-subject path retains its prior full custom roster behavior. Source wiring and existing compact-roster laws cover the boundary.
2026-08-21: MSG_CORPSE_QUERY's display-map position draws POIIcons skull cell 7 at 0.11 of the minimap side inside the current 0.8 aperture.
